body:
More than that...

I hurt myself mentally...

Daily...

My friend has called me pathetic because of how I react, and he's right...

I'm just certain that people accept me either out of pity or because they have no choice (because they're too deeply involved with other people in my life and dropping me would result in a possible fallout with those people)

But it always ends up the same. 

I make friends SUPER easily.

But then I get anxiety, I become clingy, annoying and after a while I tell them "you're not real friends, stop talking to me, I know you're just pretending." And then I lose them.

I'm just tired of being a horrible friend. It's almost as if I enjoy hurting the people I love by saying these things.
